reviewItem.question: Does "Line removed from cmd/crossplane/core/core.go: log.Info(\"Composition Functions are GA and cannot be disabled. The --enable-composition-functions flag will be…" mean a change to cli-flag:crossplane|name=--enable-composition-functions|component=core (removed)?

proposed.statement: Crossplane v2.0.0 removed from cmd/crossplane/core/core.go the deprecation handling for --enable-composition-functions — the notice stating that Composition Functions are GA, cannot be disabled, and that the flag will be removed in a future release is gone, indicating the deprecated no-op flag was removed in v2.0.0.
